title: Daytona USA
overview:
High-speed real-time 3D CG at over 300 km/h changes the history of racing games!!

A virtual reality world built from fully textured polygons awaits your challenge.

From which viewpoint will you seize victory?! Four viewpoints you can switch between smoothly.

Daytona USA puts you behind the wheel of the number 41 Hornet stock car in Sega's arcade racer. Pick a beginner, medium or long circuit and race a crowded field from the back of the pack toward first place while the timer counts down. Choose automatic or manual transmission, and pull into the pit lane to repair damage from crashes into walls and rivals.

- 1 player
- Beginner, medium and advanced circuits
- Racing Controller support
- Memory backup support

300Km/hオーバーのハイスピード・リアルタイム3D CGがレースゲームの歴史を変える!!

フルテクスチャーポリゴンで構成された仮想現実の世界が君の挑戦を待っている。

どの視点で勝利を手にするか?!
スムーズに切り替えが可能な4つの視点。
